surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves alternating exposure to trimethylaluminum (TMA) and hydrogen sulfide (H2S) plasma. The TMA reacts with surface hydroxyl groups to form Al-O-Al(CH3)2 species, followed by a H2S pulse to regenerate OH sites and incorporate sulfur into the lattice.
evidence: The text describes the ALD process for Al-doped MoS2, stating that the supercycle consists of N MoS2 ALD cycles followed by 1 AlSx cycle. Each ALD cycle includes a precursor exposure (TMA for AlSx), purge, H2S plasma exposure, and purge. The reaction equations and intermediate species are inferred from the described ALD process and the chemical nature of the precursors and reactants.
